verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only fragments of settlement legibility. Circle Mint converts USD to and from USDC 'at no additional cost', and community users corroborate no-fee par redemption. CPN and Gateway claim near-instant, 24/7 or instant transfers, and webhooks report resource state changes. Missing for 10: documented timing from payment to available balance, a published fee schedule per rail (e.g., CPN FX/payout fees, CCTP/Gateway fees), and any statements, reports or accounting exports.
